lines.text: After Jehoshaphat returned safely to Jerusalem, Jehu son of Hanani rebuked him for helping the wicked.
Jehu said Jehoshaphat had removed the Asherah poles, and Jehoshaphat went out from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim.
Jehoshaphat appointed judges in the fortified cities of Judah and told them they were judging for the king.
In Jerusalem he appointed Levites, priests, and family heads to judge, and told them to warn people so they would not incur debt.
Amariah the chief priest was over matters of the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael was over matters of the king.
